outlook.statement: Strategic expansion towards becoming an integrated Agri-FMCG through nutraceuticals & wellness products; deepening integration across edible oils and agri-commodities value chain; accelerating branded FMCG and wellness portfolio expansion; enhancing global presence through UAE platform

The management continues to be optimistic towards the external economic environment and expects consumer demand to become more consistent and robust in the current financial year. Further, various policy decisions taken would act as growth channel for the Company which would contribute in increased revenues and higher margins.

The Company announced its strategic expansion plan to establish 100 new 'Neat Everyday' stores/outlets by March 2028 to strengthen its retail footprint and enhance customer accessibility across key markets.

Global growth expected at 3.1% in 2026 and 3.2% in 2027; India GDP growth projected at 6.6% in FY27; India nutraceuticals market projected to reach USD 84.99 billion by 2033 (CAGR 10.3%); Castor oil market driven by bio-based chemicals, pharmaceutical excipients, specialty lubricants; Cotton market projected to reach USD 53.5 billion by 2031 (CAGR 3.85%); India rice market projected to reach USD 12.37 billion by 2034 (CAGR 2.0%); Global wheat market estimated to reach USD 248.32 billion by 2031 (CAGR 4.58%); Global soybean oil market projected to reach USD 73.27 billion by 2034 (CAGR 3.34%)

A well-defined risk management mechanism covering the risk mapping and trend analysis risk exposure potential impact and risk mitigation process is in place. The objective of the mechanism is to minimize the impact of risks identified and taking advance actions to mitigate it. The mechanism works on the principles of probability of occurrence and impact if triggered. A detailed exercise is being carried out to identify evaluate monitor and manage both business and non-business risks.
